meta.title: Verified findings dataset

status_vocabulary.verified: Value read directly from an official government or SEC source during this session. Source URL recorded.
status_vocabulary.derived: Arithmetic computed by this project from two or more verified values. The formula is recorded in the `formula` field. Inputs are verified; the arithmetic is reproducible.
status_vocabulary.flagged: Value came from an official source but has a material caveat (wide margin of error, vintage mismatch, or a null returned by the source). Read the note before relying on it.
status_vocabulary.unverified: No official source could be retrieved for this value in this session. The value cell is BLANK by design. It has NOT been inferred, estimated or filled in.
status_vocabulary.assumption: A modelling assumption, not a fact. Supplied by the reader in the private calculator. Never presented as data.

meta.geography_note: The parcel's real address and coordinates are NOT in this repository and have deliberately not been researched. All spatial figures are computed for a CENTRAL LOS ANGELES REFERENCE POINT at latitude 34.0537, longitude -118.2428 (the Los Angeles Civic Center). These are trade-area proxies for 'central Los Angeles', not parcel-level facts.
meta.revision: 2026-11-26 third-pass audit (session arena/60fa27c2-jackbox3): live re-verification of geography, ACS, BLS, USGS, FEMA NFHL/NRI, CAL FIRE, SEC EDGAR and FTB/BOE/BEA sources. EC-18 added (LA County personal income 2024, BEA 26-08). TX-11 and TX-12 promoted from unverified to verified (BOE change-in-ownership FAQ; FTB Form 593 2026 instructions). EC-16 note updated: BEA discontinued metro GDP statistics with BEA 26-08. EC-05 note refined to the verified Jan 2024–Oct 2026 window. H-08 re-queried: s1d now returns 0.785 while sm1/sd1/sdc1 are still null. No previously published verified value was changed; no unverified value was filled in.

findings.metric: Property tax reassessment on change of ownership (Proposition 13 base-year rules)
findings.value: Reassessed to current fair market value as of the date of change in ownership
findings.note: Verified 2026-11-26 from BOE official guidance: on a change in ownership the county assessor REASSESSES the property to current fair market value as of the date ownership changed (Pub 29; change-in-ownership FAQ). Only the portion that changes ownership is reassessed. This is a material after-sale cost to a buyer and therefore affects the achievable price. Not legal or tax advice.

findings.metric: California source rules and nonresident withholding on the sale

Applicability and exemptions (including for no/zero gain or California-source residence questions) are determined at escrow. Not legal or tax advice.
